summary: Frontend test of CombinedBulletinRenderer single-flat-table refactor on Master Digital Marketing 2026 / period 'Bulletin bts' (composite of Semestre 1 + BTS Blanc), student Bernard Lucas. ALL acceptance criteria pass. The bulletin renders ONE single table (data-testid='combined-flat-table' present, wrapper data-testid='combined-bulletin' present) with the correct Simple-style column structure: MATIERES | FORMATEUR | COEFFICIENT | MOYENNE (split into MOYENNE DE L'ETUDIANT and MOYENNE DE LA PROMO) | APPRECIATION. The old per-period block testid 'combined-source-bulletin-*' is fully removed (0 occurrences in DOM and source). The body lists the 6 module rows from both source periods in source order: SEO/DIGITAL/REFER (Semestre 1) then SEO/DIGITAL/REFER (BTS Blanc), each tagged with data-testid='combined-row-{periodId}-{moduleId}'. Footer single row reads: 'MOYENNE GENERALE' (label spans MATIERES+FORMATEUR cols) | total coef = 6 | moy étudiant = 11.50 | moy promo = 12.25 | DECISION = ADMIS — confirming the new weighted-by-coefficient combined average across ALL modules of all periods. No runtime errors ('is not defined', undefined property, ReferenceError) thrown during render.

issues: Typo in directeur header label: 'DIERECTEUR DE L'ETABLISSEMENT' should be 'DIRECTEUR DE L'ETABLISSEMENT' (CombinedBulletinRenderer.tsx:406)

Typo in italic helper line below: '(nom, prenom, signature et cachet de letablissement)' should be '(nom, prénom, signature et cachet de l'établissement)' — missing apostrophe in 'l'établissement' (CombinedBulletinRenderer.tsx:407). Same typos exist in SimpleBulletinTemplate / BTS Blanc by visual parity, but only the combined renderer was modified in this iteration.

action_items: OPTIONAL polish: fix the two French typos in CombinedBulletinRenderer.tsx lines 406-407 ('DIERECTEUR' → 'DIRECTEUR' ; '(nom, prenom, signature et cachet de letablissement)' → proper accents/apostrophes).

PRE-EXISTING (NOT a blocker, unrelated to this change): Edge Function compute-bulletin returns CORS / 404 / 400 from origin https://audit-complete-12.preview.emergentagent.com (used by Saisie/Calcul flow via bulletinComputeService). The CombinedBulletinRenderer correctly bypasses this — it computes locally with computeStudentPeriodBulletin — but the same period rendered via the Calcul & Validation tab will still fail. Recommend whitelisting the preview origin on the Supabase Edge Function CORS or fall back to client-side compute everywhere.
